description: Get the top co-occurring words and phrases from TV news clips matching a query — the vocabulary framing a topic on television. Returns the most frequent non-stopword terms from matching clips, with relative frequency scores (0–100, where 100 = the query term itself). Use to understand narrative framing, identify related concepts mentioned alongside a topic, or generate follow-up search terms. TV data spans 2009–October 2024.

endDatetime.description: End datetime in GDELT format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS — exactly 14 digits, no separators (e.g. 20200131235959). Must pair with startDatetime; supplying only one of the two is rejected.

query.description: Search query for TV transcript content. Same TV operators as gdelt_search_tv: station:CNN, network:CBS, market:"National", show:"Anderson Cooper", context:"vaccine".

startDatetime.description: Start datetime in GDELT format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS — exactly 14 digits, no separators (e.g. 20200101000000). Must pair with endDatetime; supplying only one of the two is rejected. TV data spans 2009–October 2024.

stations.description: Station IDs to filter to (e.g. ["CNN", "FOXNEWS"]). The GDELT TV API requires at least one station — supply it here, or embed a station: selector directly in query. Omitting both is rejected; it does not fall back to all stations. Use gdelt_list_tv_stations to see valid IDs.

timespan.description: Time window, e.g. "1m", "6m". Ignored when startDatetime/endDatetime are set. TV data spans 2009–October 2024.

name: gdelt_get_tv_context

effectiveQuery.description: Echoed query string for use in follow-up calls.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_range`: Only one of startDatetime / endDatetime was supplied, one of them is not a real UTC calendar timestamp, or startDatetime is not earlier than endDatetime. `invalid_query`: GDELT rejected the query — no station was selected, or the query string is malformed. `gdelt_rate_limited`: GDELT rejected the request for its one-request-per-five-seconds limit, or too many requests were already queued for this one to start in time. `gdelt_unavailable`: GDELT TV API is unreachable or temporarily returned no usable data. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no clips matched, so there is no vocabulary to report — the resolved timespan window, the October 2024 archive cutoff, and how to broaden the query or check station coverage. Absent when terms were returned.

totalCount.description: Number of clips from which co-occurrences were computed. Absent when the upstream API does not return a clip count.

words.description: Co-occurring terms sorted by score descending.

items.description: A co-occurring term with its relative frequency score.

score.description: Relative frequency score (0–100). The query term itself scores 100; other terms are proportional to their co-occurrence frequency.

title: Get GDELT TV Context
